name: ca-05-plan-editor
description: Audit pass 5 — the 2D plan editor: entry transition, room selection + inspector, wall selection, labels, compass, and the left rail tools.

steps.name: dismiss-first-run
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: select-biggest-room
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); const fp = s.floorPlan; const rooms = (fp.levels ? fp.levels.find(l => l.id === fp.activeLevelId)?.rooms : null) ?? fp.rooms ?? []; const big = rooms.reduce((a, b) => (a && a.width * a.depth >= b.width * b.depth ? a : b), rooms[0]); window.__auditRoom = big.id; s.setPlanSelection({ type: 'room', id: big.id }); return big.name ?? big.id

assert.message: renamed room label should appear in the plan UI
